lessons.title: Structuring Your Page
lessons.description: Organise your portfolio into meaningful sections using semantic HTML
hints: Put <header> before your h1 and </header> after your tagline.

Each section looks like:

Skills
All five sections go between <main> and </main>; the footer goes after </main>.

lessons.title: Text, Images and Links
lessons.description: Write your About Me section with formatted text, an image and links
hints: An image is written as ; it has no closing tag.
Wrap a phrase in and to mark it as important.
A link is LinkedIn.

lessons.title: Styling with CSS
lessons.description: Use CSS to control colours, fonts and spacing on your portfolio
hints: Each declaration is property: value; and must end with a semicolon.
Copy the suggested values from the comments in the CSS tab into the empty rules.
If a style does not appear, check the selector is spelt the same as in your HTML.

lessons.title: Component: Skills List
lessons.description: Present your skills as a styled list of tags
hints:

In the CSS, list-style: none; removes the bullet points.
display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; puts the items in a row that wraps.

lessons.title: Component: Project Cards
lessons.description: Showcase your work with a responsive grid of project cards
hints: Copy the whole first <article class="card"> ... </article> and paste it twice, then change the text.
The cards must stay inside <div class="card-grid"> for the grid to work.
grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); makes the grid responsive.

lessons.title: Navigation and Contact
lessons.description: Add in-page navigation, contact links and a footer
hints: Add id="about" to the About section's opening tag: <section id="about">
A nav link to it is About; the # means "on this page".
An email link is Email.

lessons.title: Final Task: Your Portfolio Template
lessons.description: Bring everything together and personalise your own portfolio template
hints: Work through the checklist one item at a time and check the preview after each change.
Search the HTML for [ and Your Name to find any placeholder text you have missed.
Use the Download button to save your work before trying the extension challenges.
